inputs.endpoint: api/xbrl/companyfacts/CIK0000718877.json
inputs.query: https://data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyfacts/CIK0000718877.json

A company delisted in 2023 still answers, each fact with the date it was filed and its form, a quarter's figure filed again as a comparative in later filings beside the filing that first stated it.
